$comment: Single source of truth for Orion's visual design. Edit HERE, then run build-tokens.py to regenerate the CSS block in the mockup and the Swift constants in the app. Never hand-edit the generated output.

color.$comment: Neutrals are deliberately near-perfectly neutral. A gray biased toward the accent reads as 'considered' in most interfaces; in a raw editor it reads as a color cast and corrupts the judgment the app exists to support.

surround.use: Canvas surround — what the photo is judged against

accent.use: Interactive and active states ONLY. Never decorative.

filmBase.use: Film base — the darkest value in the interface, under the strip

filmHole.use: Sprocket perforations and the rebate edge — a hole shows the light through

space.$comment: 4px base grid. Panel padding is 14 rather than 16 — pro tool panels want density.

type.$comment: System face throughout. On macOS this IS SF Pro, so the mockup renders exactly what SwiftUI will.
